title: The Scientific method of the lab
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：scientific　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scientific 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of ① a scientific method of the lab in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② so scientific that nobody in the harbour would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the scientific ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the scientific method of the lab that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too scientific to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the scientific ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a scientific study of the river, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as scientific as the study of the river they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was scientific or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something scientific, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite scientific; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the scientific ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, with great care, she wrote of another scientific method of the lab in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less scientific than anybody had expected. ⑩ The scientific study of the river that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the scientific ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 科学（前置定语 a scientific method of the lab：1957 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件科学的方法）
B. adj. 科学／系统（两处加强说法：so scientific that … 与 no less scientific than …）
C. adj. 科学／系统（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 科学（表语 too scientific to do：母亲觉得它太科学，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 系统（前置定语 a scientific study of the river：叔叔把整件事称作一桩系统的研究）
F. adj. 系统（同级比较 as scientific as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对那条河的系统研究相比）
G. adj. 系统（后置定语 something scientific：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 系统（受程度副词修饰 quite scientific：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a scientific method of the lab
the scientific method of the lab that
a scientific study of the river
The scientific study of the river that

answers.why: scientific 意为“科学”，1957 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件科学的方法”，此处作前置定语 a scientific method of the lab。
scientific 意为“科学”，此处用 so scientific that 结构，说它科学到渔港里没人敢靠近。
scientific 意为“科学”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的科学实验室的科学方法，等于最高级的说法。
scientific 意为“科学”，母亲认为这件东西“太科学了，谁也用不上”，too scientific to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
scientific 意为“系统”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩系统的研究”，此处作前置定语 a scientific study of the river。
scientific 意为“系统”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对那条河的系统研究一样系统”，同级比较用 as scientific as。
scientific 意为“系统”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“系统的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something scientific。
scientific 意为“系统”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当系统”，quite 修饰原级 scientific。
scientific 意为“系统”，no less scientific than 表示“其系统不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之系统不亚于任何人的预料。
scientific 意为“系统”，母亲 1969 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的系统研究”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件科学的方法。（a scientific method of the lab）
它科学到渔港里没有一个人敢靠近。（so scientific that …）
母亲觉得它太科学，谁也用不上。（too scientific to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩系统的研究。（a scientific study of the river）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对那条河的系统研究一样系统。（as scientific as …）
到了 1964 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件系统的东西。（something scientific）
answers: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of a scientific method of the lab in the logbook.
It was so scientific that nobody in the harbour would go near it.
My mother thought it too scientific to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a scientific study of the river.
He said nobody would call it as scientific as the study of the river they had once had.
By 1964 the logbook asked for nothing but something scientific.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 scientific 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of a scientific method of the lab in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the scientific method of the lab that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too scientific to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a scientific study of the river, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite scientific, and everybody laughed.
The scientific ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
